notes_for_editor: Two web searches and the MSU Mississippi Forestry Association photo records (two read, no Panola or Benton entries) found nothing on a Batesville lookout. A third-party tower listing (towerdex.com/tower/1236405, seen only as a search result, not read) describes a roughly 91 m structure in Batesville with a county board of supervisors as owner; nothing ties it to a lookout, so it is not used.
